name: AFFiNE
description: There can be more than Notion and Miro. AFFiNE(pronounced [ə‘fain]) is a next-gen knowledge base that brings planning, sorting and creating all together. Privacy first, open-source, customizable and ready to use.
one_liner: A privacy-first app that combines a Notion-style notes/docs workspace with a Miro-style visual whiteboard in one tool, and you can run it entirely on your own machine.
buyer: A small team or privacy-conscious professional who likes Notion and Miro but doesn't want their company's planning data sitting on someone else's servers.
business_use_cases: A consulting boutique adopts it as their internal knowledge base because clients require data to stay on-premise.
A startup uses it to run product planning (docs + whiteboard) in one tool instead of paying for both Notion and Miro.
An agency white-labels a self-hosted instance as part of a 'private workspace' offering for security-sensitive clients.

money_ideas.idea: Offer managed, private-cloud hosting and setup of AFFiNE for companies with compliance requirements.
Sell migration services helping teams move their existing Notion/Miro content into AFFiNE.

steal_this: Offer a 'migrate your team from Notion to a private AFFiNE instance in a weekend' service to privacy-conscious small businesses.
